command:
mkdir -p docs/audit-evidence-20261111/advanced-vm/resource-ui
cp /tmp/xen-resource-ui-20261111/actions.json /tmp/xen-resource-ui-20261111/edit-after-release.png /tmp/xen-resource-ui-20261111/cpu-three-review.png /tmp/xen-resource-ui-20261111/cpu-three-result.png /tmp/xen-resource-ui-20261111/running-storage.png docs/audit-evidence-20261111/advanced-vm/resource-ui/
ssh -o BatchMode=yes root@192.168.8.170 python3 - <<'PY'
import XenAPI,json
s=XenAPI.xapi_local();s.xenapi.login_with_password('','','1.0','owned-live-test-setup')
try:
 r=s.xenapi.VM.get_by_uuid('0d519e7a-b2af-f269-0bda-fb3ade4bfc62');v=s.xenapi.VM.get_record(r)
 assert v['name_label'].startswith('zz-parity-advanced-01a1c95c-52b8-7065-a5f7-367cb4007421') and not v['is_a_template']
 if v['power_state']=='Running':s.xenapi.VM.clean_shutdown(r)
 assert s.xenapi.VM.get_power_state(r)=='Halted'
 platform=s.xenapi.VM.get_platform(r);platform['viridian']='true';s.xenapi.VM.set_platform(r,platform)
 s.xenapi.VM.set_VCPUs_at_startup(r,1);s.xenapi.VM.start(r,False,False)
 v=s.xenapi.VM.get_record(r)
 print(json.dumps({'phase':'linux-viridian-ui-setup','uuid':v['uuid'],'power_state':v['power_state'],'viridian':v['platform']['viridian'],'vcpus':v['VCPUs_at_startup'],'maximum':v['VCPUs_max']}))
finally:s.xenapi.session.logout()
PY
